This is the real reason `lint` is failing — not the merge-guard parser cases that the last run addressed.

- _push_targets records only whether --repo was supplied; _evaluate_bash obtains the repository slug through repo_slug(target.cwd), which reads remote.origin.url. | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard does not check the repository selected by `--repo`.
  WHY: A push such as `git push --repo=<other-repository> HEAD:feature/x` is checked against the checkout’s origin instead of the destination repository. If that destination has a merged PR for feature/x but the checkout’s origin does not, the guard allows a push the merged-PR check should block.
- Relay._reject (lines 102-104) and Relay.do_POST (lines 111-131) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Early request validation rejects and closes the connection before consuming the request body.
  WHY: The broker’s client-authorization test sends a POST body with an unauthorized Authorization header, then raises `BrokenPipeError` instead of receiving the expected 400 response. CI confirms this failure in tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py::test_broker_rejects_client_authorization, causing tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and the aggregate lint check to fail.
